messages.body:
**4. Asynchronous hop 1: the worker polls the database**

Nothing notifies the worker; it finds the new order on its next pass. `Run` starts one such loop per phase (worker/worker.go:28-38); the interval is set to 2 s in cmd/shop/main.go:31. The orders phase lists every open order and calls `processOrder` on each with its own timeout (:58-79). Each pass handles one state transition, so everything below is spread over many passes.
